Value.Name: INFO_STRTRUNCATED
Value.Description: A string has been truncated as its length exceeds the maximum length allowed in the context.

Value.Name: INFO_SUBITEMDROPPED
Value.Description: A subitem within a VIB or VIT was dropped (not handled).

Value.Name: INFO_TODAYNOTAVAIL
Value.Description: A query request was denied because today's information is not yet available.

Value.Name: INFO_TXDUPITEM
Value.Description: The transaction included at least one instrument that was given twice. Each instrument shall only be present once.

Value.Name: INFO_UNKNOWNOPER
Value.Description: The requested operation is out of range and could not be handled.

Value.Name: INFO_WRONGCHILDSTATE
Value.Description: The operation requires all children to an upper level instrument to be prepared, but at least one child was in the wrong state for this.
